eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 7:59 AM on AUG 11, 2025 Effective until 5:59 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix, Arizona. Phoenix Police is looking for James Edward Wilson, 61-year-old white male being six feet tall, 170 pounds, with gray hair and brown eyes. James was last seen on Sunday, August 10, 2025, between 9:30 AM and 10:30 AM leaving his residence in the area of North 40th Street and East Belleview Street on foot. He was last seen wearing a gray faded Air Force t-shirt, blue jeans and tennis shoes. James suffers from a medical condition which may cause him to be confused and easily lost. If you have any information on James Wilson, please contact Phoenix Police Department.

If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates. If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
